title: Implementation chapter
description: A real system that can be reconstructed coherently — NOT a bug bucket. 'UI bugs', 'backend bugs', 'notifications bugs' and 'miscellaneous' are backlog categories and are invalid chapters. The worked standard is Rich Content, which resolved into Content Truth / Reference & Retention Truth / Fail-Closed Ingestion / Governed Delivery / Processing / Rich Acquisition / Rich Presentation.

purpose.description: Governing purpose — what this chapter exists to make true.

rootDeficiency.description: The architectural deficiency being corrected, not the symptom list.

cRelationship.description: Which of C0..C11 this chapter serves. A chapter may supersede a simplistic reading of a C-phase WITHOUT erasing that C-phase's purpose.

canonicalFindings.description: Findings this chapter OWNS. Exactly one chapter may own a given finding.

crossReferencedFindings.description: Findings this chapter AFFECTS but does not own. 0..N. Never a substitute for ownership.

findingStates.description: State per owned finding, copied verbatim from Stage 0. Any divergence is an R6 violation.

wgAbsorbed.description: World-class opportunities absorbed here because reconstruction is the safest time to implement them. Remain separately traceable by WG id.

protectedBoundaries.description: Protected systems this chapter comes near. Meetings, Realtime, Live and C4-owned findings must be named explicitly wherever relevant.

founderDecisions.description: Outstanding decisions. These stay decisions — converting one into an engineering assumption is an R8 violation.

completionDefinition.description: What must be TRUE for this chapter to be complete — including certification, not merely implementation.
